shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | sed -n '1,120p'
printf '\\n--- component ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' app/ContactForm.tsx
printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
printf '\\n--- agents ---\\n'
sed -n '1,160p' AGENTS.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/forms.md
printf '\\n--- server actions guide ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/server-actions.md
printf '\\n--- use server directive ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-server.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort
printf '\\n--- source references ---\\n'
rg -n \"saveContact|contact message|ContactForm|server action|use server\" -g '"'!node_modules'"' ."

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx
printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx
printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json
printf '\\n--- next config ---\\n'
sed -n '1,160p' next.config.ts
printf '\\n--- CLAUDE ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' CLAUDE.md
printf '\\n--- GEMINI ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' GEMINI.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short
git diff --check -- app/ContactForm.tsx
git diff -- tsconfig.json app/ContactForm.tsx
find .next -type f -delete && find .next -depth -type d -empty -delete || true
git status --short'
